chapter: Buddy Petit's switch, death and family
title: Buddy Petit's funeral and his widow in Mandeville
summary: They discuss that Buddy Petit had no band at his funeral, that his wife went home to Mandeville, and plan a visit to find her.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Did Buddy have a band, Piper's funeral?
Uh, let me see. No. No, no. We did have any band. No band?
I thought there was a band. I wasn't here. No, we didn't.

I thought I read the rest of the rest. I don't think his wife wanted a band. I just remember that. That's right. No band. No, he didn't have a band for a funeral. Now, his wife didn't want a band. Yeah. He didn't have a band. That's right. That's right. That's right. That's right. So he gave the right from the house. That's right. To St. Louis.
The Catholics, of course, don't usually have music anymore. They did, I guess, 50 years ago.
Yeah, they did. They did a few years ago.
But was he Catholic? Do you remember? Was it a Catholic funeral?
I would remember.
I just remember his wife is still living right now in Monroe, Louisiana. She went back going after Buddy died. Why is he still living there? She's still living there. No.
Theresa. Young daughter's hall. Isn't that hall still up? In Vanderbilt? Where Mooney used to live. Sons and daughter's hall? Yeah. Still up. I saw it last time, but is that hall still up? Still up.
That hall is still there in the hall. Still up there. Still there in the hall. And his wife left here, but his wife went to take home with it.
You don't have her address, do you?
Well, I'll tell you. It's very easy, because it's a small town. You could get her. Any time you hit the town, anybody would tell you. Causey, you know.
Causey, you know.

Causey, you're right in Mandeville. Yeah. And after Theresa, we used to call her Theresa Gibson. But, uh. Theresa Gibson? Gibson. That's what we used to call her. Theresa Gibson. That's how she used to call her. Yep. She was married for the petite.
You think she would be married again and have a different name now? Well, she did, yes.
She's mad, but I don't know this. Somebody would know her, though. They would know her. Small town. Yes, she's still over there. I'm pretty much sure.
I'd like one day we'd make an appointment. We'd take a ride over there.
We can.
We can. That'd be nice. Take a little trip over there.
That's a little short trip. Yeah. I would talk with her. I would talk with her. I would take a call. Yeah.
